acceptance: The allowlist entries added on 2026-11-17 are removed and the audit passes on `next`.
Explorer tests, the site build, the browser suites and the visual comparison pass; any visual change is reviewed.
context: Filed 2026-11-17 when a new dependency advisory blocked a site docs PR; the owner chose a patch bump plus a time-limited allowlist and deferred the major upgrades here.
description:
## Problem
On 2026-11-17 high advisories were published for picomatch (GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf) and vite 6.4.4 (GHSA-8g5g-mxqh-grgj), reached through the explorer's dev and build tooling (vitest, tailwindcss, @preact/preset-vite, sucrase, chokidar). The `dependency audit` CI job on benchbox-site `next` then failed for every PR. By owner decision, vite was bumped to 6.4.6 and the remaining dev-only advisories were allowlisted in `explorer/scripts/audit-high-allowlist.json` with `review_by` 2026-12-17. `npm audit fix` stops on a peer conflict (`vitest@5.0.3` needs vite `^6.4.0 || ^7 || ^8`); the remaining fixes need major upgrades.

## Change
Upgrade vitest, tailwindcss and @preact/preset-vite (and vite if they require it) to versions without the advisories, fix any breakage, and remove the allowlist entries.

## Decision gates
The implementer chooses the target versions. A tailwindcss major that changes generated CSS needs a visual comparison of the site and explorer before merge.

## Verification rubric
Pass: `explorer/scripts/audit-high.mjs` passes with the entries removed; explorer unit tests, the site build, the browser suites and the visual comparison pass in CI. Fail: extending `review_by` without an upgrade, or allowlisting a runtime dependency.

## Guardrails
- Site repository rules: a PR to `next`, then to `main` with the next release.
- No change to shipped runtime behaviour beyond what the upgrades require.
